scope: Maintainer delta-only queue review. Archive integrity is distinct from scientific acceptance.

findings.issue: Git batch reader mishandles a tree entry; pinned-edit stale-digest detection can falsely succeed, invalidating claimed predecessor report parity.

Caller factory/root and launch-cwd mismatch; subsequent snapshot consumes child wait before numeric process-group signalling. Later proposed source repairs are not substantive acceptance of these original snapshots.

Compiler fit uses largest target rank145 instead of literal carrier153. Author corrections report minima2086,2096,2104,2118,2121 respectively; written2100 fails in the last three. Original checks still use max(Tq). Require committed proof/check revisions and exact or interval verification.

validation.ledger: scripts/verify_pr_ledger_markdown.py passed after each changed batch
validation.limits: Serial targeted execution; 180 seconds per command and sampled 1GiB descendant RSS. Initial sparse-fixture failure and an empty test selection retained and corrected. No native scientific, Lean, Docker or all-history replay; no hosted run dispatched.
validation.archive_checks: Changed-file Git modes/blobs, Python/JSON syntax, recognized source-manifest pins interpreted under their actual schemas, exact tracked top-level VERIFY inputs, observed claim/comment scope, current heads, and all-open-head ancestry checks. This is not comprehensive semantic manifest validation or independent scientific proof.
